provenance.note: Curated compilation of MMR lake-restoration programmes and court/NGT orders - per-record `source` citations carry the accountability; an aggregate description is not an upstream source. The recurring pattern documented: cosmetic beautification substituting for water-quality restoration (see legacy note).

note: Active and recent lake-restoration programmes and court/NGT orders across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, compiled 2026-06 from sourced reporting. Figures are as reported; where a scheme spans water supply and lake works, only the lake-relevant scope is summarised. The recurring pattern across Thane, Kalyan, Panvel and Mira-Bhayandar is cosmetic beautification (tracks, fountains, boating) substituting for water-quality restoration.

projects.scheme_name: Thane 'City of Lakes' Lake Beautification & Conservation (AMRUT 2.0)
projects.scope: 15 lakes - protective walls, jogging tracks, bioremediation, aeration, floating wetlands and CCTV (incl. Brahmala, Kacharli, Railadevi, Ambe Ghosale, Kausa, Khidkali).
projects.status: In progress (target ~2024). The beautification model itself is contested - citizens at Kavesar, Upvan and Railadevi argue hardscaping degrades living wetlands.

projects.scope: 8 MLD STP at the Powai Udanchan Kendra + sewage diversion (8 MLD to Bhandup STP, ~2 MLD to Mithi STP) + hyacinth removal.
projects.status: Underway; the STP is not to be commissioned until 11 December 2027, so ~18 MLD of sewage continues meanwhile.

projects.scope: Dewatering, water testing and restoration/beautification of the ~200-year-old Grade-II heritage Lotus Tank.
projects.status: Consultant appointed; tank dewatered May 2026. Activists question the cost and approach.

projects.scope: Biological control of invasive Salvinia (>1 lakh weevils released) after a Rs 13 cr beautification (2021) and the 2024 cancellation of a boating phase on ecological grounds.
projects.funding_summary: Rs 11.8 lakh weevil campaign (2026-27); Rs 13 cr earlier beautification
projects.status: Weevil campaign running Apr 2026 - Oct 2027; the cleanest nature-based arc in the outer MMR.

projects.scope: Conservation Reserve status for the Talawe/Seawoods tidal wetland linked to the Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary.
projects.status: Approved 17 Apr 2025 - but a CIDCO de-reservation resolution followed within weeks; protection contested.

court_orders.case: Dr Rakesh Bakshi v BMC (Powai Lake)
court_orders.concern: ~18 MLD untreated sewage inflow (BMC affidavit ~10.9 MLD); eutrophication and hyacinth.
court_orders.ruling: A joint committee (CPCB/MPCB/State Wetland Authority) RECOMMENDED a Rs 5 lakh-per-inlet monthly penalty on BMC for Powai's sewage inflow (recommended, not imposed); the 8 MLD STP is not due until Dec 2027.

court_orders.concern: Idol-immersion pollution of a sacred heritage tank.
court_orders.ruling: Refused immersion of even eco-friendly idols in Banganga Talao - 'Right to Clean Water Prevails'.

court_orders.concern: Plaster-of-Paris and immersion pollution across all MMR lakes and creeks.
court_orders.ruling: All Ganesh idols up to 6 ft (clay or PoP) must be immersed in artificial ponds provided by civic bodies statewide; PoP not in natural water bodies without leave of court (2025 season / to March 2026).

court_orders.concern: Repeated illegal construction-debris dumping linked to Navi Mumbai airport works.
court_orders.ruling: Directed NMMC to protect Lotus Lake (Nerul, Sector 27) and report by 29 Apr 2025; lake cleared and fenced.

court_orders.writ_petition: Bombay HC (2018); SLP pending in Supreme Court
court_orders.concern: Reclamation of a flamingo-bearing tidal wetland.
court_orders.ruling: Struck down a proposed golf course with a total ban on reclamation of NWIA wetlands; the developer's Special Leave Petition is still pending in the Supreme Court.

court_orders.concern: Illegal landfilling of a mapped wetland.
court_orders.ruling: Notices to BMC/MCZMA/Konkan Wetland Committee over alleged illegal landfilling of a 191.39 ha wetland; matter pending.
